newsitem.title: BULGARIA: NO DEALS ON BULGARIA STOCK MARKET, RABSI FLAT.
newsitem.headline: NO DEALS ON BULGARIA STOCK MARKET, RABSI FLAT.

text.p: The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Tuesday's 41.14 points as there were no deals in corporate paper on local bourses, brokers said.

Bank for Agricultural Credit shares were offered at 900 levs on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) but there no bidders. Teximbank shares were also offered there at 800 levs, below the par of 1,000 but they attracted no bids.

Varna Grand Hotel stocks were bid at 85 levs on the BSE but no one offered, traders said. Bulgarleasing shares were also bid there at 1,100 levs against par of 1,000 but there were no shares on offer.
There were no offers or demand for corporate stocks on the Sofia Stock Exchange and no repo deals in treasury paper either.
